definitions.gloss: juniors; younger people following in one's field
definitions.explanation: People who come after one in the same field, workplace or school, especially those one trains or makes way for.

examples.japanese: {後進|こうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{譲|ゆず}る→譲る：02323_yuzuru⟧。
examples.english: To make way for the younger generation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後進|こうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The company is putting effort into training its younger staff.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現役|げんえき}→現役：21782_geneki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{後進|こうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧にあたって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Since retiring from competition, she has been coaching the next generation.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後進|こうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{譲|ゆず}る→譲る：02323_yuzuru⟧: to step aside for younger people
- {後進|こうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧: training successors
- {後進|こうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧: guiding juniors

WATCH OUT:
- {後進国|こうしんこく} ("backward country") is dated and now considered offensive; use ⟦{発展途上国|はってんとじょうこく}→発展途上国：22732_hattentojoukoku⟧ (developing country).
- Homophones: ⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧ (renewal, update), ⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧ (march), ⟦{交信|こうしん}→交信：20101_koushin⟧ (communication).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧: one's junior at school or work, an everyday word for a specific person; {後進|こうしん} is formal and means juniors as a group
